theorem etcdstart.id_ne (id₁ id₂ id₃ : w64) (Hlow : (List.map (fun id => uint.Z id % 2 ^ 16) [id₁,

    id₂ ∧ id₁ ≠ id₃ ∧ id₂ ≠ id₃

theorem etcdstart.alloc3 [v3rpc_sem : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions]
    (id₁ id₂ id₃ : w64) (ps : List w64) (hperm : ps.Perm [id₁, id₂, id₃]) (ctxs : List (List w8))
    (boot : List LogEntry) (Hlow : (List.map (fun id => uint.Z id % 2 ^ 16) [id₁, id₂, id₃]).Nodup)
    (Hlow0 : ∀ (id : w64), id ∈ [id₁, id₂, id₃] → uint.Z id % 2 ^ 16 ≠ 0) (HB : BootLog ps ctxs
    boot) (Hcc : etcdstart.bootCCOk ps (LogEntry.toEntries boot 0)) (Hurl : bootURLsOk
    (LogEntry.toEntries boot 0)) (dir : w64 → List GoString) (a₁ a₂ a₃ : GoString) (Hd0 : dir 0 =
    []) (Hhost : ∀ (i : w64) (h : GoString), go!"http://" ++ h ∈ dir i → h = a₁ ∨ h = a₂ ∨ h = a₃)
    (Hrb : receiptBound GF ≤ 2 ^ 64 - 2) (Hrb2 : receiptBound GF + boot.length ≤ 2 ^ 61) (n₁ n₂ n₃ :
    GoString) (c₁ c₂ c₃ : Option GoString) (lm : lease.Mode) (hrun : lease.runCfg lm lm) (hrev : lm
    ≠ lease.Mode.revocable) (cmp : Bool := false) (cret : Nat := 0) : ⊢ bootMarshal ps ctxs
    (LogEntry.toEntries boot 0) -∗ etcdstart.memberStartRes n₁ { peer := some a₁, client := c₁ } -∗
    etcdstart.memberStartRes n₂ { peer := some a₂, client := c₂ } -∗ etcdstart.memberStartRes n₃ {
    peer := some a₃, client := c₃ } ={⊤}=∗ ∃ γ reg₁ reg₂ reg₃ ρ₁ ρ₂ ρ₃ E₁ E₂ E₃ Φs γn, ⌜γ.vs = ps ∧
    γ.rule = srvRule (W64 0) (LogEntry.toEntries boot 0) ∧ γ.boot = LogEntry.toEntries boot 0 ∧ γn.N
    = srvNet γ ∧ γn.dir = dir ∧ ρ₁.rd.kv.log0 = [[], []] ∧ ρ₂.rd.kv.st = ρ₁.rd.kv.st ∧ ρ₃.rd.kv.st =
    ρ₁.rd.kv.st ∧ kvModel ρ₂.rd.kv = kvModel ρ₁.rd.kv ∧ kvModel ρ₃.rd.kv = kvModel ρ₁.rd.kv ∧
    ρ₂.rd.kv.log0 = [[], []] ∧ ρ₃.rd.kv.log0 = [[], []] ∧ kvSame ρ₂.rd.kv ρ₁.rd.kv ∧ kvSame ρ₃.rd.kv
    ρ₁.rd.kv ∧ ρ₁.rd.kv.cmp = cmp ∧ ρ₁.rd.kv.cret = cret⌝ ∗ etcdstart.memberBoot { cl := γ.cl, vs :=
    γ.vs, rule := γ.rule, boot := γ.boot, reg := reg₁, snapLoc := γ.snapLoc, log := γ.log, fresh :=
    γ.fresh, props := γ.props, fired := γ.fired, rdFresh := γ.rdFresh, pend := γ.pend, authOn :=
    γ.authOn } ctxs ρ₁ E₁ Φs id₁ cmp lm ∗ (netHttpOk γn id₁ ∗ etcdstart.memberFreshRes n₁ { peer :=
    some a₁, client := c₁ } γn) ∗ etcdstart.memberBoot { cl := γ.cl, vs := γ.vs, rule := γ.rule,
    boot := γ.boot, reg := reg₂, snapLoc := γ.snapLoc, log := γ.log, fresh := γ.fresh, props :=
    γ.props, fired := γ.fired, rdFresh := γ.rdFresh, pend := γ.pend, authOn := γ.authOn } ctxs ρ₂ E₂
    Φs id₂ cmp lm ∗ (netHttpOk γn id₂ ∗ etcdstart.memberFreshRes n₂ { peer := some a₂, client := c₂
    } γn) ∗ etcdstart.memberBoot { cl := γ.cl, vs := γ.vs, rule := γ.rule, boot := γ.boot, reg :=
    reg₃, snapLoc := γ.snapLoc, log := γ.log, fresh := γ.fresh, props := γ.props, fired := γ.fired,
    rdFresh := γ.rdFresh, pend := γ.pend, authOn := γ.authOn } ctxs ρ₃ E₃ Φs id₃ cmp lm ∗ (netHttpOk
    γn id₃ ∗ etcdstart.memberFreshRes n₃ { peer := some a₃, client := c₃ } γn) ∗ if decide (lm ≠
    lease.Mode.none) = true then True else etcdKV ρ₁.rd.kv (kvModelSt ρ₁.rd.kv (bootEntries
    (LogEntry.toEntries boot 0)))

theorem etcdstart.pfx_ne (id₁ id₂ id₃ : w64) (Hlow : (List.map (fun id => uint.Z id % 2 ^ 16) [id₁,
    id₂, id₃]).Nodup) (Hlow0 : ∀ (id : w64), id ∈ [id₁, id₂, id₃] → uint.Z id % 2 ^ 16 ≠ 0) :
    idPfxOf (W16 (uint.Z id₁)) ≠ idPfxOf (W16 (uint.Z id₂)) ∧ idPfxOf (W16 (uint.Z id₁)) ≠ idPfxOf
    (W16 (uint.Z id₃)) ∧ idPfxOf (W16 (uint.Z id₂)) ≠ idPfxOf (W16 (uint.Z id₃))

theorem etcdstart.id_nz (id₁ id₂ id₃ : w64) (Hlow : (List.map (fun id => uint.Z id % 2 ^ 16) [id₁,
    id₂, id₃]).Nodup) (Hlow0 : ∀ (id : w64), id ∈ [id₁, id₂, id₃] → uint.Z id % 2 ^ 16 ≠ 0) (id :
    w64) : id ∈ [id₁, id₂, id₃] → id ≠ W64 0
